description: Train your focus, memory and math skills. Train your brain with fun mini games that challenge your memory, focus, logic and math skills. Braincup offers 45 brain training exercises to sharpen your mind and improve concentration. Mental Calculation: Follow the math expressions. Use each result as the base for the next. Chain Calculation: Solve complex formulas step by step. Sherlock Calculation: Find a formula to reach the goal using only the given numbers and operators. Fraction Calculation: Solve the fractions. Value Comparison: Select the expression with the highest value. Bubble Sum: Add the numbers on the floating bubbles. Quick Sum: Numbers flash one at a time. Add them up and enter the total. Anomaly Puzzle: Find the figure that stands out. Pattern Sequence: Work out the rule running along each row, then pick the piece that completes it. Path Finder: Start at the marked cell and follow the arrows to the destination. Visual Memory: Memorize the shapes, then identify the hidden one when the timer ends. Ghost Grid: Watch the tiles light up one by one, then tap them back in the same order. Color Confusion: Tap the color a word is printed in, not the color the word names. Colored Shapes: Add up the points from the correct statements. Orbit Tracker: Watch the highlighted balls, then track them as they move. Flash Crowd: Dots flash briefly on each side. Tap the side that had more dots. Mini Sudoku: Fill the grid so every row, column and block holds each number exactly once. Mini Chess: Checkmate the CPU before it checkmates you. Solo Chess: Capture pieces until only the king remains. Every move must capture. Lights Out: Turn off every light. Each tap toggles the cell and its four neighbours. Sliding Puzzle: Slide tiles into the empty space to put them back in order. Shikaku: Divide the grid into rectangles, each holding one number equal to its area. Nurikabe: Paint the sea around numbered islands, never forming a 2x2 block. Cat Queens: Place one cat per row, column and color zone. No two may touch, not even diagonally. Knot: Connect each pair of colored dots. Paths may not cross and must fill every cell. Tower of Hanoi: Move the full stack to the right peg. Schulte Table: Tap the numbers in order from 1 upwards as fast as you can. Flags: Identify the country by its flag. Digit Memory: Memorize a digit sequence, solve a quick math problem, then recall it. Spot the New: Tap the animal you have not seen before. N-Back: Tap Match when the shape repeats the one N steps back. Wordle: Guess the hidden five-letter word in six tries. Matchstick Riddles: Move matchsticks to fix broken equations. Peg Solitaire: Jump pegs to clear the board down to one peg. Sudoku: Classic full-size Sudoku with multiple difficulties. Chess: Full chess vs CPU or pass-and-play with a friend. IQ Test: 30 matrix puzzles in 15 minutes, with an estimated IQ. Just for fun. Missing Operators: Find the missing operators (+, -, *, /) that make the equation true. Bulls & Cows: Guess the secret 4-digit number with unique digits. Simon Says: Each round adds one pad. Tap the whole sequence back from the start. Prism Clear: Swap tiles to clear lines of three or more. Empty the board to win. Trio: Find three cards that share a shape, a count or a fill. Mental Rotations: Is the second block the first one turned, or mirrored? Mental Flex: The pair at the top says which trait counts: shape or color. Rule Shift: Sort each card onto a key card. Nobody tells you the rule, and it changes once you have it. Several achievements, and every exercise has medals to keep you motivated. No tracking. Open source.
